Run: python life_calibrate.py (writes Saved/AnimPipeline/life_calibration_result.json, prints <= 5 lines, CALIB: OK only if every clip is present and matches). Dumps: Tools/CI/Save-Assets.ps1 -Script Tools/AnimPipeline/gstn_anim_mcp/clip_joints_dump_ue.py with CJD_ASSETS=<the asset names below> (headless, saves nothing; mannequin/animpipe clips CJD_FACING=y) -> Saved/AnimPipeline/runstart/joints_<asset>.json. 'card' gives contact, effector, class and declared holds.
